text_block_list.text:
On the way back after having Tokai Teio 
accompany me to buy supplies—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm so tired from all this walking~. Hey, 
hey, wanna take a quick break?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! Well then, let's hit a cafe, a cafe♪

Obliging Tokai Teio's wish, we headed over 
to a nearby open-air café, and then—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh, it's Teio-chan and the others~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo! Are you getting in here too, 
Mayano?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh♪ I'm so glad you asked!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya came here to drink black coffee, you 
know~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing adult flavors means taking 
off one step ahead of Teio-chan☆!♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmh! Even I can drink black coffee!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, Mayano, hurry up and get 
inside!

After heading inside, Tokai Teio and 
Mayano Top Gun ordered black coffee just 
as they had declared.

A few minutes later, the girls took a sip 
of their drinks, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Urgh.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: B-Bitter...!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Not "so"! The bitterness gives it a nice 
grown-up vibe, doesn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, yeah~! Though isn't it a bit too 
early for Mayano~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
T-Teio-chan, you're the one making a face 
like you ate a sour plum~!

It seems neither of their palates can 
handle the bitterness of black coffee...
choice_data_list:
Why not save the grown-up flavors for next 
time?
I'm starting to crave something sweet~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't do that! I've got my pride on 
the line too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya too! A mature woman never gives up 
easily!
choice_data_list:
Enjoying a variety of flavors is part of 
being an adult too.

text_block_list.text:
When I told the two, who were still 
stubbornly digging their heels in, they 
both fell completely silent.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Y-You might actually have a point.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A grown-up with refined taste... that's 
the kind of person you are, right?

The two looked at each other, nodded, and 
began pouring sugar, milk, and syrup into 
their black coffee one after another.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A-All finished drinking! Does this make 
Maya more grown-up than before?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Well, you're still no match 
for me, though!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!? Teio-chan, don't let your hate of 
losing get out of hand~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you talking about yourself, 
Mayano~? Because my victory is completely 
set in stone!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Right, Trainer!? You think so too, don't 
you!?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? Fine then, I'll drink all kinds 
of stuff and show you how grown-up I am!

Afterward, Tokai Teio and Mayano Top Gun 
kept ordering sweet drinks, thoroughly 
enjoying their "grown-up time."

Competing with her friend seemed to give 
Tokai Teio something valuable to take 
away.

The moment I muttered that, I felt both of 
their gazes turn straight toward me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so~? Come to think of it, I feel 
like I'm getting hungry too~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya too, Maya too! Pancakes with heaps of 
whipped cream sound so good, right...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Since Trainer is ordering anyway, why 
don't we order something too?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Totally!

And the two of them ordered a dessert to 
erase the bitterness of the black coffee.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, thanks for the meal!

Thanks to the sweet dessert, the two of 
them managed to finish their black coffee.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Those pancakes were so yummy~☆ I'm totally 
ordering them again next time I come!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The fruit parfait was delicious too! The 
soft serve was so rich and creamy~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆ This means Maya and the others are 
getting more and more grown-up!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Trainer, I bet you barely 
recognized me, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez! That was your cue to say 'Yeah!' and 
praise me~!

Tokai Teio had a pout on her face, but 
after I apologized for my slip of the 
tongue and praised her, her mood instantly 
improved.

It seemed Tokai Teio also gained something 
from spending some "grown-up time" with 
Mayano Top Gun.
